abstract: Master Your English Using Collocations by Sanjay K. Jha and Sristi Sansmriti Jha is an engaging, practical guide to mastering English naturally, confidently, and effectively. Build fluency, enrich your expression, and communicate with greater confidence. Unlock the secret to natural English—one powerful word combination at a time!

abstract: A Linguistic Insight into English–Hindi Human and Machine Translation by Sanjay K. Jha and Bijay K. title: Comparative Literature: Themes & Contexts

abstract: Explore the fascinating connections between world literatures, cultures, and ideas in Comparative Literature: Themes & Contexts, an insightful scholarly work by Dr. S. Chelliah, an accomplished academic and literary critic. Through compelling comparative studies of celebrated writers such as Rabindranath Tagore, Kahlil Gibran, Jane Austen, Ernest Hemingway, and Charles Dickens, the book explores universal themes of love, spirituality, identity, humanism, gender, and social justice. Bridging Eastern and Western literary traditions, it offers fresh perspectives on how literature reflects the shared experiences of humanity. Ultimately, the book presents comparative literature as a means of fostering intercultural understanding and recognizing the common threads that connect humanity through literary expression. An essential addition to the bookshelf of literature students, researchers, teachers, and passionate readers seeking a deeper understanding of world literature.
